terminals.name: convex
terminals.description: Convex local (anonymous) backend + codegen watcher. Configures an isolated anonymous deployment, writes .env.local with NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL, and serves the leads API on port 3210. Anonymous agent mode keeps it from conflicting with any personal Convex deployment.

terminals.name: next
terminals.description: Next.js 16 dev server (Turbopack) on http://localhost:3000. Reads NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL from .env.local so the contact form submits leads to Convex.
